title: Invesco Canada announces cash distributions for its ETFs
description: Invesco Canada announced the November 2024 cash distributions for its exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Unitholders will receive the distributions on December 6, 2024.

title: Invesco Ltd: Form 8.3 - Aviva PLC; Opening Position disclosure
description: Invesco Ltd. has disclosed its 1.65% stake in Aviva PLC and Direct Line Insurance Group PLC. The disclosure includes details of Invesco's positions and dealings in the relevant securities.

title: Invesco Ltd: Form 8.3 - Loungers PLC; Opening Position disclosure
description: Invesco Ltd. has disclosed a 4.36% stake in Loungers PLC, a UK-based hospitality company. The disclosure is made in accordance with the UK Takeover Code.

title: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. Announces Quarterly Common Dividend
description: Invesco Mortgage Capital Inc. (IVR) announced a quarterly common dividend of $0.40 per share, payable on January 24, 2025 to stockholders of record as of December 30, 2024.

title: Correction: Invesco Ltd: Form 8.3 - Aviva PLC; Public dealing disclosure
description: This is an amendment to a previously submitted form, with changes made to Sections 2(a) and 3(a). The disclosure relates to Invesco Ltd.'s interests and dealings in the relevant securities of Aviva PLC and Direct Line Insurance Group PLC.

title: Invesco Ltd: Form 8.3 - International Paper Co; Public dealing disclosure
description: Invesco Ltd. disclosed its ownership of 7,950,815 shares (2.28%) in International Paper Company. The company also disclosed its dealings in International Paper Company and Smith (DS) PLC shares.
